m: साह् See 2. सह्, p. 1193, col. 1.
साहानुसाहि m. N. of a king, Pañcad.
साहाय w.r. for सहाय.

s: klI, (sahAyasya BAvaH karmma vA । sahAma + “yopaDAt gurUpottamAt vuY .” 5 । 1 । 132 । ityatra sahAyAdveti vaktavyam ityukteH pAkziko vuY .) sAhAyyam । sahAyasya BAva ityarTe kaRpratyayena nizpannam ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 17 । 5 । “sa kulocitamindrasya sAhAyakamupeyivAn । jaGAna samare dEtyaM durjayaM tena cAvaDi ॥”)
m: साहायक n. (fr. सहाय) assistance, aid, help, Kāv.; Kathās.
a number of associates or companions, MW.
auxiliary troops, ib.
a: साहायकं — 1 Assistance, help aid; स कुलोचितमिंद्रस्य साहायकमुपोयिवान् R. 17. 4. --2 Fellowship, alliance, friendship. --3 A number of companions or associates. --4 Auxiliary troops.

s: klI, (sahAyasya BAvaH karmma vA । sahAya + pakze brAhmaRAditvAt zyaY .) sahAyatA । sahAyaSabdAt zRyapratyayena nizpannam ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 155 । 19 । “sAhAyye'smi sTitaH pArTa ! pAtayizyAmi rAkzasam ॥”
m: साहाय्य n. help, succour (˚य्यं-√ कृ and √ स्था, ‘to give assistance’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
friendship, fellowship, alliance, W.
(in dram.) helping another in danger, Sāh.
a: साहाय्यं — 1 Assistance, help, succour. --2 Friendship, alliance.

m: साहाय्य—दान n. the giving of aid or assistance, ib.
साहाय्यक n. aid, assistance, Daś.
साहाय्य—कर mfn. giving assistance, helping, Daś.
1. साह mfn. (fr. √ सह्) powerful, mighty, RV.
(also षाह ifc.) resisting, conquering, subduing, MBh.
2. साह m. = شاه (see प्रदीप- and मधुकर-स्˚).
साहंकार mfn. having egotism or self-conceit, proud, arrogant, Rājat.; Kathās.
साहंकार—ता f. self-conceit, arrogance, Pañcad.
साहंकृत mfn. self-conceited, proud, haughty, Siṃhās.
साहञ्ज m. N. of a king, Hariv.
साहञ्जनी f. N. of a town built by Sāhañja, ib.
साहञ्जि m. = साहञ्ज, VP.
साहचर mfn. (fr. सह-च्˚) belonging to the plant Saha-cara, Suśr.
साहचर्य n. companionship, fellowship, society, association with (instr. or comp.), Nir.; Kāv. &c.
a: साहचर्यं — Companionship, (constant) fellowship or association, living together, concomitance; किं न स्मरसि यदेकत्र नो विद्यापरिग्रहाय नानादिगंतवासिनां साहचर्यमासीत् Māl. 1; Ku. 3. 21, R. 16. 87, Ve. 1. 20, Śi. 15. 24. --Comp. --नियमः a rule of invariable concomitance.

s: klI, (sahacarasya BAvaH karmma vA । sahacara + zyaY .) sahacarasya BAvaH । (yaTA, kumAre । 3 । 11 । “maDuSca te manmaTa ! sAhacaryyAdasAvanukto'pi sahAya eva samIraRo nodayitA Baveti vyAdiSyate kena hutAsanasya ॥”) sahagamanam । sahacaraSabdAt zRyapratyayena nizpannam ॥ sahacAraH । sAmAnADikaraRyam । ekADikaraRavfttitvam । yaTA, -- “prAyaSo rUpaBedena sAhacaryyAcca kutracit .” ityamaraH ॥ (sahaDarmmAcaraRam । iti mallinATaH ॥ yaTA, raGuH । 16 । 87 । “tasyAH spfzwe manujapatinA sAhacaryyAya haste mANgalyorRAvalayini puraH pAvakasyocCiKasya ॥”)
v: na॰ sahacarasya BAvaH vyaY । 1 samaBivyAhAre, 2 sAhitye 3 sAnanADikaraRye ca ।

m: साहदेव m. patr. fr. सह-देव, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 114, Sch.
साहदेवक m. a worshipper of Saha-deva, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 99, Sch.
साहदेवि m. patr. fr. सह-देव, MBh.; Rājat.
साहदेव्य m. patr. of Somaka, RV.
साहजिक mfn. (fr. सह-ज) innate, natural, Vṛṣabhān.
साहजिक m. N. of a man, Rājat.
साहजित् m. v.l. for साहञ्जि, VP.
साहकायन mfn. (fr. सहक, v.l. for सिंहक), g. पक्षादि.
साहन n. (fr. Caus. of √ सह्) the act of causing to bear
sufferance, endurance, W.
साहन्त्य mfn. = सहन्त्य, conquering, powerful, AV.; TS.
साहपदीन or साहव्˚अदीन, m. N. of a Sultān, Inscr.
साहसाध्यवसायिन् mfn. acting with inconsiderate haste, MW.
साहसाङ्˚कीय mfn. relating to Sāhasāṅka, Cat.

s: puM, (sAhasaH eva aNkaScihnaM yasya .) vikramAdityarAjaH । iti jawADaraH ॥
m: साहसाङ्क m. ‘marked or characterized by daring’, N. of king Vikramāditya, Pañcad.
of a poet (mentioned by Rāja-śekhara)
of a lexicographer, Cat.
साहसाङ्क—चरित n. N. of wk.
साहसैकान्त-रसानुवर्तिन् mfn. one who follows or yields to the one passion of cruelty or rashness, MW.
साहसैक-रसिक mfn. one whose only feeling or passion is cruelty, brutal, ferocious, W.

s: klI, (sahasA balena nirvfttam । sahas + “tena nirvf ttam .” 4 । 2 । 68 । iti aR .) daRqaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 21 ॥ sa ca triviDaH । yaTA, yAjYavalkyaH । “sASItipaRasAhasro daRqa uttamasAhasaH । tadUrdDaM maDyamaH proktastadardDamaDamaH smftaH ॥” iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥ balAtkArakftakAryyam । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, “vegaroDAt kzayAccEva sAhasAdvizamASanAt । tridozo jAyate yakzmA gado hetucatuzwayAt ॥” iti mADavakarasaMgfhItarugviniScaye yakzmADikAre ॥ “sAhasAditi sAhaso balavadvigrahAdirUpaH kzoBahetutvena kAraRatvam ॥” iti tawwIkAyAM vijayarakzitaH ॥ * ॥ duzkftakarmma । avimfzyakftiH । (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 42 । 1 । “yadyetat sAhasaM tAta ! yadi vA duzkftaM kftam priyaM vApyapriyaM vA te vAguktA na mfzA Bavet ॥”) dvezaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ praScAddozamanAlocya karaRam । tattu cIryyaparadAragamanAdi । iti mugDaboDawIkAyAM durgAdAsaH ॥ * ॥ sAhasamAha nAradaH manuzyamAraRaM steyaM paradArABimarzaRam । pAruzyamanftaYcEva sAhasaM paYcaDA smftam ॥” atra sadya evottaradApanam । yaTA, -- sAhasasteyapAruzyago'BiSApAtyaye striyAm । vivAdayet sadya eva kAlo'nyatrecCayA smftaH ॥” vivAdayet sadya evottaraM dApayet । iti SUlapARiH ॥ tatra dAsAdayo'pi sAkziRo Bavanti yaTA, uSanA । “dAso'nDo vaDiraH kuzWI strIbAlasTavirAdayaH । ete'pyanaBisambanDAH sAhase sAkziRo matAH ॥” iti vyavahAratattvam ॥ (tadyukte, tri । yaTA, harivaMSe BavizyaparvvaRi । 39 । 37 । “na jAne iti yadbrUze kimataH sAhasaM vacaH ॥”)
puM, (sahase balAya hitaH । sahas + aR .) agniviSezaH । yaTA, -- “prAyaScitte viDuScEva pAkayajYe tu sAhasaH । lakzahome ca vahniH syAt kowihome hutASanaH ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
v: na॰ sahasA balena nirvfttam aR । 1 malena kfte cOryya strAsaMgrahAdO duzwakarmaRi, “sahasA kriyate yattu tat sAhasamiti smftamiti” smftiH । tadvivftiH vIrami॰ “tasya svarUpamAha nAradaH “sahasA kriyate kama yatkiYcidbaladarpitEH । tatsAhasamiti proktaM sahobanamihocyate” iti । tasya cAturviDyamAha vfhaspatiH “manuzyamAraRaYcOryaM paradArABimaSanam । pAruzyamuBayaYceti sAhasaM syAccaturviDam” iti । uBaya pAruzyaM vAgdaRqapAruzye । tatra trEviDyamAha nAradaH “tatpunastriviDaM jYeyaM praTamaM maDyamantaTA । uttamaYceti Sastrezu tasyoktaM lakzaRaM pfTag” iti । etezAM svarUpamAha sa eva “PalamUla dakAdInAM kzetropakaraRasya ca । BaNgAkzepopamardAdyEH praTamaM sAhasaM smftam । vAsaHpaSvannapAnAnAM gfhopakaraRasya ca । etenEva prakAreRa maDyama sAhasaM smftam । vyApAdo vizaSastrAdyEH paradArABimarSanam । prARoparoDi yaccAnyaduktamuttamasAhasam” iti । BaNgaH PalAdi svarUpanASanam । Akzepa AkroSaH vAktiraskaraRamiti yAvat । upamardaH svarUpAvaSezeRa pIqanam । etenEvaMprakAreRetyarTaH । triviDe'pi sAhase daRqamAha nAradaH “tasya daRqaH kriyApekzaH praTamasya SatAvaraH । maDyamasya tu SAstrajYErdfzwaH paYcaSatAvaraH । uttame sAhase daRqaH sahasrAvara izyate । baDaH sarvasvaharaRa purAnnirvAsanANkane । tadaNgacCeda ityukto daRqa uttamasAhase” iti । brAhmaRasya tu mahatyapyaparADe SArIradaRqABAvamAha sa eva “aviSezeRa sarvezAmeza daRqaviDiH smrataH । baDAdfte brAhmaRasya na baDam vrAhmaRo'rhatIti” । yamo'pi “na SArIrA brAhmaRasya daRqABavati kasyacid iti । mahatyaparADa brAhmaRasya daRqamAha sa eva “kzityA tu banDane badDvA rAjA BakzaM pradApayet” iti । nAradA'pi “SirasomuRqanaM daRqastasya nirvAsanaM purAt । lalAwe cABiSastANkaH prayARa NgardDaBena ca iti । paradrazyApaharaRarUpasAhasasvarUpaM tatra ca daRqamAha yAjYavalkyaH “sAmAnyadravyaprasaBaharaRa sAhasaM smftam । tanmUlyAd dviguRo daRqo nihnava tu caturguRaH” iti । bahuBirjanEH praharAdikAlakrameRa rakzyamARasya dravyasya balAtkAreRa haraRaM sAhasarUpaM steyamiti pUrvArdDArTaH । tanmUlyAdapahftadravyamUlyAt । nihnave apalApe । yaH sAhasaM taroti taddviguRandamam । yastu sAhasaM kftvA nihnute sa caturguRandApya ityuttarArdgArTaH । sAhasikasya payojayitAraM pratyAha maeva “yaH sAhasaM kArayati sa dApyo dviguRandamam । yaScEvamuktvAhandAtA kArayetsa caturguRam” iti । dviguRandamaM sAhasikadaRqAddviguRaM daRqam । sAhasikaviSezaM pratyAha sa eva “aDyAMkroSAtikramakfdBAtfBAryyAMprahAradaH । gaMdiTasyApradAtA ca samudragfhaBedakft । sAmantakulikAdInAmapakArasya kArakaH । paYcASatpaRiko daRqa ezAmiti viniScayaH । svacCandaMviDavAgAmI vikruzwenABiDAvakaH । akAraRena vikrozwA cARqAlaScottamAn spfSan । SUdrapavajitAnAYca dEve pitrye ca BojakaH । ayuktaM SapaTaM kurvan ayogyo yogyakarmakft । vfzakzadrapaSUnAYca puMstvasya pratiGAtakft । sADAraRasyApalApI dAsIgarBavinASakft । pitfputrasvasfBrAtfdampatyAcAryaSizyakAH । ezAmapatitAnyonyatyAgI ca SatadaRqaBAg” iti । “ajYAnakarttfke sAhasike pitrAdibAnDavAH । prazwavyA rAjapuruzEH sAmAdiBirupakramEH । vijYeyo'sADusaMsargAccihnerhoQena vA narEH । ezoditA GAtakAnAntaskarARAYca BAvanA । gfhItaH SaNkayA yasta na tatkAryaM prapadyate । SapaTenAvabodDavyaH sarvavAdezvayaM viDiH” iti । cihnaM raktalepAdi hAQImftasya DanAdikam । jYAnAnantarakarttavyamAha vyAsaH “jYAtvA tu GAtakaM samyak sasahAya sabAnDavam । hanyAccitrabaDopAyErudbejanakarErnfpaH” iti । vfhaspatiH “prakASaGAtakA ye tu taTA copAMSuGAtakAH । jYAtvA samyagDanaM hftvA hantavyA viviDErbaDEH” iti । vrahmaGna kzatriyAdivizayametat । yata Aha bODAyanaH “kzatriyAdInAM brAhmaRasya baDe baDaH sarvasvaharaRaYca tezAmeva tulyApakfzwabaDe yaTAbalamanurUpaM daRqaYca kalpayoditi” tezAM kzatriyAdInAntulyApakfzwabaDe sajAtIyahInajAtIyabaDe daRqaM SArIradaRqam । ekaGAtArTapravfttAnAM bahUnAndozAnurUpaM daRqamAha kAtyAyanaH “ekaYcedbahavo hanyuH saMrudDAH puruzannarAH । marmaGAtI tu yastezAM sa GAtaka iti smftaH” । yo marmaGAtakaH sa eva baDApanADawaRqaBAgityarTaH । sa eva “AramBakftsahAya dAzavaktA'nudeSakaH । ASrayaH SAstradAtA ca BaktadAyo vikarmiRAm । yudDopadeSakaScEva tadvinASapravarttakaH । upekzAkAryyayuktaSca dozavaktAnumodakaH । anizedDA kzamo yaH syAt sarve te kAryyakAriRaH । yaTASaktyanurUpantudaRqamezAM prakalpayet” iti । vfhaspatirapi “ekaYca bahavo yatra praharanti ruzAnvitAH । marmaprahArako yastu GAtakaH sa udAhftaH । marmaGAtI tu yastezAM yaToktaM prApayeddamam । AramBakftsahAyaSca dozaBAgI tadardDataH । kzatasyAlpamahattvaYca marmasTAnaYca yatnataH । sAmarTyaYcAnuvanDaYca jYAtvA cihnEH prasADayet” iti । vizayaviSeze manuzyabaDakatturdaRqABAvaM dozABAvapradarSanaparAnAha manuH “SastraM dvijAtiBirgrAhyaM Darmo yatroparuDyate । dvijAtInAYca varRAnAM viplave kAlakArite । AtmanaSca paritrARe dakziRAnAYca saNgare । strIviprAByupapattO ca Gnan DarmeRa na duzyati” iti । yatra deSe kAle ca DarmastawAkAdirUpoBedatacCedanadinA'paruDyate taTA SUdretaravarRasaNgare paradArAkramaRAdirUpe rAjABAvakAlakArite । taTAtmanaH parataH prARasaSaye । taTA dakziRAnAM saNgare gograhaRanimittake yudDe । taTA strIviprAByupapattO durbalahiMsAnivAraRe । DarmAdDetorGran na duzyati yataH । atastatra dvijArtiBiH kzatraDarmASrayaRarahitErapi samarTEH SastraM grAhyamityanvayaH । atra dvijAtigrahaRaM brAhmaRavESyavizayam । prajApAlanArTaM kzatriyasya vacanAntareREva Sastra grahaRasya prAptatvAdityaBisanDAyEva bODAyana Aha “brAhmaRArTe gavArTe ca varRAnAM vApi saNgare । gfhRIyAtAM vipraviSO SastraM Darmavyatikrame” iti । yattu “parIkzArTamapi brAhmaRa AyuDannAdadIta” ityApastambavacanam । yacca boDAyanavacanam “hAsyArTamapi brAhmaRa AyuDaM nAdadIteti taddvayamapi DarmoparoDAdiBinnavizayam । sAhasasteyasya kroDaloBakftatvamAha vfhaspati “sAmprataM sAhasasteyaM SrUyatAM kroDaloBajam” iti । strIsaMgrahaRAKyasAhasasvarUpamAha sa eva “anicCantyA yat kriyate suptonmattapramattayA । pralapantyA vA rahasi balAtkArakftantu tat” iti । anicCantyA parapuruzeRa saheti SezaH । anicCantyA yAni cihnAni tasyAH karttavyaM rAjakatavyaM cAha saMvarttaH “necCantyA yAni cihnAni balAtkArakftAni ca । parapuMsaH prasaNgezu nArIRAntAni SfRvataH । naKadantakzatakzAmAsakacagrasavIkzitA । sadyo niSvAsitA nArI balAtkAreRa dUzitA । uccErvikroSayantI ca rudantI lokasanniDO । tasya nAmavadantI ca yaTAhantena dUzitA । SocedevaMviDErliNgErvraRokftapayoDarA । cihnAlaNkArakeSESca vyAkulIkftalocanA । rAjYA saByEH saBAM nItvA svayamanvizya tatkzaRAt । yad brUyAt sahajaM tatra tat karttavyaM prayatnataH । vivAde sAkziRAmatra prakurvIta parigraham । prArTanAdaBiSastasya na divyaM dAtumarhati” iti । atra daRqamAha manuH “sahasraM brAhmaRo daRqyo viprAM guptAM valAdvrajan iti । guptAM svaniyamena rakzitAm । kzatrivAdizavarRavizaye daRqamAha vfhaspatiH “sahasA kAmayed yastu DanantasyAKilaM haret । utkftya liNgavfzaRO BrAmayed gardDaBena tu” iti । kAmayet parastriyaNgacCet । ayameva daRqo'nulomapratilomajAtyoH sajAtIyaparaBAryyAgamane veditavya iti madanaratne । hInajAtIyaparastrIgamane brAhmaRAdizvetadardDaparimito daRqaH । utkfzwajAtIyaparadAragamane ayameva daRqo baDasahitaH kAryya ityAha sa eva “damoneyaH samAyAntu hInAyAmaDikastataH । puMsaH kAryo'DikAyAntu gamane sapramApaRam” iti । damaH sahasA kAmayediti vAkyoktaH । neyaH prApaRIyaH । yattu baDamAtrABiDAyakaM kAtyAyanavacanam “strIzu kftopaBogaH syAt prasahya puruzo yadA । baDe tatra pravartteta kAryyAtikramaRaM hi tad” iti । tannirguRasya BAryyAgamane veditavyam” । sahasA avivekena kftaM karma । 2 avimfzyakftakarmaRi, tri॰ । “tena sAhasamanuzWitaM punaH” kAvyapra॰ 3 sAhasamanusarati aR । smftyukte 3 daRqaviSeze pu॰ “sASItipaRamAhasrodaRqa uttamasAhasaH । tadardDaM maDyamaH proktastadardDamaDamaH smftaH” smftiH । “pAkayajYe tu sAhasa” ityukte 4 agniBede ca pu॰ ।
m: साहस mfn. (fr. सहस्) over-hasty, precipitate, rash, inconsiderate, foolhardy, Hariv.
साहस m. N. of Agni at the Pāka-yajña, Gṛhyās.
साहस m. n. punishment, fine (regarded as of three kinds, the highest being called Uttama; half of that, Madhyama; and half of that, Adhama), Mn.; Yājñ. &c.
साहस (अम्), n. (ifc. f(आ). ) boldness, daring, rashness, temerity, any precipitate or reckless act, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
n. overstraining, Car.
violence, force, rapine, rape, robbery, felony, aggression, cruelty, Gaut.; Āpast.; Nār.
adultery, Nār.
hatred, enmity, L.
a: साहसं — [सहसा बलेन निर्वृत्तं अण्] 1 Violence, force, rapine; Ms. 7. 48. --2 Any criminal act (such as robbery, rape, felony &c.), a heinous crime, an aggressive act. --3 Cruelty, oppression; Śi. 9. 59. --4 Boldness, daring, daring courage; साहसे श्रीः प्रतिवसति Mk. 4. --5 Precipitation, rashness, temerity, an inconsiderate or reckless act, a rash or daring act; तदपि साहसाभासं Māl. 2; किमपरमतो निर्व्यूढं यत्करार्पणसाहसं 9. 10; Pt. 1. 191; Ki. 17. 42. --6 Punishment, chastisement, fine (m. also in this sense), see Ms. 8. 138; Y. 1. 66, 365. --Comp. --अंकः {1} an epithet of king Vikramāditya. {2} of a poet. {3} of a lexicographer. --अध्यवसायिन् a. acting rashly or with inconsiderate haste. --एकरसिक a. wholly intent on violence, ferocious, brutal. --कारिन् a. {1} bold, audacious. {2} rash, inconsiderate. --लांछन a. characterized by boldness.

k.v: साहसं तु दमो दण्डः साम सान्त्वमथो समौ। भेदोपजापावुपधा धर्माद्यैर्यत्परीक्षणम्.।

m: साहस—कारिन् mfn. acting inconsiderately or rashly, Ratnāv.
साहस—करण n. violence, force, Daś.
साहस—कर्म-ता f. rashness, temerity, Mṛcch.
साहस—लाञ्छन m. N. of a man (cf. साहसाङ्क), Vcar.
साहस—वत् mfn. inconsiderate, rash, foolhardy, VarBṛS.

m: साहसिक mf(ई)n. bold, daring, impetuous, rash, reckless, inconsiderate, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
using great force or violence, perpetrated with violence, cruel, brutal, ferocious, rapacious, Mn.; MBh.
overstraining or overworking one's self, Car.
punitive, castigatory, W.

a: साहसिकः — a. (की f.) [साहसे प्रसृतः ठक्] 1 Using great force or violence, brutal, violent, rapacious, cruel, felonious. --2 Bold, daring, rash, inconsiderate, reckless; न सहास्मि साहसमसाहसिकी Śi. 9. 59; केचित्तु साहसिकास्त्रिलोचनमिति पेठुः Malli. on Ku. 3. 44. --3 Castigatory, punitive. --कः 1 A bold or adventurous person, an enterprising man; Pt. 5. 31. --2 A desperado, desperate or dangerous person; या किल विविधजीवोपहारप्रियेति साहसिकानां प्रवादः Māl. 1; साहिसकः खल्वेषः 6. --3 A felon, freebooter, robber. --4 An adulterer.

a: साहसिन् — a. [साहस-इनि] 1 Violent, ferocious, cruel. --2 Bold, daring, rash, impetuous.

m: साहस्र mf(ई, or आ)n. (fr. सहस्र) relating or belonging to a thousand, consisting of or bought with or paid for a th˚, thousandfold, exceedingly numerous, infinite, VS. &c. &c.

a: साहस्र — a. (स्री f.) [सहस्र-अण्] 1 Relating to a thousand. --2 Consisting of a thousand. --3 Bought with a thousand. --4 Paid per thousand (as interest &c.). --5 A thousand-fold. --स्रः An army or detachment consisting of a thousand men. --स्रं An aggregate of a thousand.
